verdict.rationale: Kimi is a consumer AI assistant, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, policy, or toggle that lets users control whether their conversations are used for model training. The docs cover coding tools, APIs, admin features and file Q&A, none of which address this.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models
